convert_tiny_autoencoder_to_diffusers: run the script to convert TAESD encoder and decoder safetensors to a diffusers AutoencoderTiny pretrained model
load_safetensors_encoder_decoder: load encoder and decoder safetensor checkpoint files using safetensors.torch.load_file
remap_encoder_state_dict: remap encoder state dict keys by prefixing them with encoder.layers for diffusers compatibility
remap_decoder_state_dict: remap decoder state dict keys by adjusting layer IDs and prefixing with decoder.layers for diffusers compatibility
save_pretrained_autoencoder_tiny: save the populated AutoencoderTiny model to a directory using save_pretrained with optional safetensors serialization
